- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal

- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings

cat > /workspace/train_model.py << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
val_df = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test_df = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Val shape: {val_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Separate features and target
y_train = train_df['target'].values
y_val = val_df['target'].values

# Drop target column
X_train = train_df.drop('target', axis=1)
X_val = val_df.drop('target', axis=1)
X_test = test_df.copy()

# Identify feature types
num_features = [col for col in X_train.columns if col.startswith('num_')]
bin_features = [col for col in X_train.columns if col.startswith('bin_')]
cat_features = [col for col in X_train.columns if col.startswith('cat_')]

print(f"Numerical features: {len(num_features)}")
print(f"Binary features: {len(bin_features)}")
print(f"Categorical features: {len(cat_features)}")

# Convert categorical columns to category dtype
cat_feature_indices = [i for i, col in enumerate(X_train.columns) if col in cat_features]
for col in cat_features:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype('category')
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].astype('category')
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype('category')

print("\nTraining LightGBM model...")
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=64,
    max_depth=-1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=-1,
    categorical_feature=cat_feature_indices
)

model.fit(
    X_train, y_train,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[]  # Disable early stopping for simplicity
)

# Validation predictions
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation ROC-AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Save predictions
output_df = pd.DataFrame({'target': test_preds})
output_df.to_csv('/app/predictions.csv', index=False)
print(f"Predictions saved to /app/predictions.csv")
print(f"Output shape: {output_df.shape}")
print(f"Output stats: min={test_preds.min():.4f}, max={test_preds.max():.4f}, mean={test_preds.mean():.4f}")
EOF
